abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.description: Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds. Eternal Vanguard Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light.; trait

fields.notes: Eternal Vanguard can pass through enemy gates.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Heal target ally for 362 Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181 Health.

fields.notes: Flash of Light applies Devotion. Flash of Light is a separate ability from Holy Light and thus does not interact with any talents affecting it.

abilities.name: Holy Radiance
abilities.description: Heal allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194 Health, dealing 177 damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.description: Deal 109 damage and Stun the target for 1 second.

fields.notes: Cast is interrupted without putting the ability on cooldown if the target moves more than 1.5 units past its maximum range. Unstoppable enemies can be targeted, but they will only be damaged upon being hit by Hammer of Justice.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.; 90; 80; heroic

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.description: Deal 170 damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.; 80; 80; heroic

talents.name: Silver Touch
talents.description: quest Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion. After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60. reward After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.
_raw_fields: quest Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion. After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60. reward After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

talents.name: Wave of Light
talents.description: quest Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance. Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds. Passive Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.
_raw_fields: quest Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance. Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds. Passive Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

talents.name: Hammer of the Lightbringer
talents.description: quest Basic Attack enemies 75 times. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds. Passive Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.
_raw_fields: quest Basic Attack enemies 75 times. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds. Passive Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.description: Holy Light can be used on an enemy to do 40% of its healing amount as damage. When used this way, Uther receives its self-healing benefits, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, and it refunds 45 Mana.

fields.notes: Benefits from all talents affecting Holy Light.

_raw_fields: Holy Light can be used on an enemy to do 40% of its healing amount as damage. When used this way, Uther receives its self-healing benefits, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, and it refunds 45 Mana.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
talents.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Holy Fire
talents.description: Deal 13 damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

fields.notes: Holy Fire is inactive while Mounted. Holy Fire does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries. Damaging enemy Heroes with Holy Fire does not trigger tower aggro. Damage from Holy Fire is unaffected by external offensive damage modifiers and lifesteal effects. Damage bonus from itself stacks additively.

_raw_fields: Deal 13 damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

talents.name: Armor of Faith
talents.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.
_raw_fields: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

talents.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
talents.description: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Hand of Protection
talents.description: Cooldown 90 Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 90 Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

talents.name: Divine Shield
talents.description: Cooldown 90 Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 90 Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Divine Storm
talents.description: Cooldown 80 Deal 170 damage and stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 80 Deal 170 damage and stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

talents.name: Blessed Champion
talents.description: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allies for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

fields.notes: Healing from Blessed Champion does not apply Devotion. The healing amount is calculated from the sum of Holy Light 's allied and self-heal after modifications (bonuses and reductions). Healing past target's maximum Health does not count toward this amount.

_raw_fields: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allies for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

talents.name: Well Met
talents.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting the target's damage output.

_raw_fields: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Spell Shield
talents.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.
_raw_fields: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

talents.name: Beacon of Light
talents.description: Uther receives 125% more self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

fields.notes: Beacon of Light will trigger whenever Uther himself is not the primary target of the cast, meaning that damaging enemies with Holy Shock also grants increased self-healing. Stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect self-healing dealt by Holy Light and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received by Uther.

_raw_fields: Uther receives 125% more self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

talents.name: Tyr's Deliverance
talents.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther’s next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

fields.type: Healing dealt modifier, Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Bonus from Basic Attack stacks up to 7 times, making the maximum bonus from the talent 80% with the base percentage. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Holy Radiance 's damage. Healing bonus stacks additively with other healing dealt modifiers that can affect healing from Holy Radiance.

_raw_fields: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther’s next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

talents.name: Benediction
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Activate to reduce the Mana cost of your next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

fields.notes: Cooldown starts after the ability is triggered by casting a Basic Ability.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 60 Activate to reduce the Mana cost of your next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Bulwark of Light
talents.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.
_raw_fields: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

talents.name: Divine Hurricane
talents.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.
_raw_fields: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

talents.name: Redemption
talents.description: After Eternal Devotion ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

fields.notes: If Redemption goes off cooldown when Uther is in Eternal Vanguard, it will trigger.

_raw_fields: After Eternal Devotion ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

talents.name: Divine Protection
talents.description: Increase Devotion's Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Affects Armor bonuses for both allied Heroes and Uther.

_raw_fields: Increase Devotion's Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.
